units: bbox = [x, y, w, h] in 1x card px of a 1920x1080 card plane (PNG pixels are 2x). Callout canvases are local px. Anchor offsets for callouts are capture CSS px (1440x900 viewport space).

reveal_rule: Word groups cut in fully on their beat frame (no fades, no per-letter animation). Holds >= 1.3 s. Riso misregistration only on colour layers (shapes, stickers, shadows); type stays registered or <= 1 px.
